samples.note: Verified libghostty behavior: VS15 changes presentation but does not narrow this emoji-default base in mode 2027.

samples.note: legacy: 1+0+0 (20E3 is combining).

samples.label: Keycap 1+U+20E3 (no VS16)
samples.note: Exercises optional-VS keycap syntax; rendering remains visual-only.

samples.label: Wave + medium tone
samples.note: legacy: 2+2 (modifiers are EAW Wide). Two glyphs at width 4 is CORRECT rendering with 2027 off.

samples.label: Rainbow flag
samples.note: legacy: 1F3F3 is EAW Neutral (1) + VS(0) + ZWJ(0) + rainbow(2) = 3. Odd widths are legacy's honest arithmetic.

samples.label: Pirate flag
samples.note: legacy: 2+0+1+0.

samples.label: Heart on fire
samples.note: legacy: 1+0+0+2.

samples.label: US (RI pair)
samples.note: UNDERSPECIFIED in legacy: wcwidth tables disagree on RI (1 or 2 each). Both 2 and 4 accepted; neither judged.

samples.label: Scotland (tag sequence)
samples.note: legacy: 2 + six tag chars at 0. Same width in both regimes; only the RENDERING differs (and rendering is not graded).

samples.label: Bracketed run: [tech+family+flag]
samples.note: brackets are INSIDE the sample: ASCII hard against both cluster edges. legacy 1+4+6+3+1. Per-sample passes do not imply run passes; edge segmentation and error accumulation only show up here.

samples.label: Adjacent flags (RI pairing parity)
samples.note: six RIs = three flags (US JP BR). A mis-pairer shows the same width with the WRONG flags: verify by eye too.

samples.label: Odd RI count (five indicators)
samples.note: cluster: US + JP + lone B = 2+2+2. The trailing lone indicator is the parity edge case. Width 2 for the lone RI is libghostty's choice; another terminal may disagree.

samples.label: ZWJ only WITHIN clusters, none between
samples.note: family then technologist, no joiner between: must stay two clusters. legacy 6+4.

samples.label: Dangling ZWJ before plain text
samples.note: UAX #29 breaks after ZWJ when the next char is not pictographic: both regimes agree on 3. Any other answer is a segmentation bug.

samples.label: CJK-edged run: 日+technologist+日
samples.note: Wide neighbors expose cluster-boundary off-by-ones: legacy 2+4+2, cluster 2+2+2.

samples.label: Right-margin wrap: grinning face
samples.note: The two-cell glyph must wrap as one unit, never split across rows.

samples.label: Four-person family, four tones (41 UTF-8 bytes)
samples.note: Control below the renderer's 64-byte cell buffer: legacy four people + four wide modifiers, cluster one family.

samples.label: Heart + 25 VS16 selectors (78 UTF-8 bytes)
samples.note: Exceeds XTP_VISUAL_TEXT_CAPACITY. Width and the following sample must remain sound; placeholder artwork is not graded.
